lines.text: Meet AI Employees: your AI team, *at work*.
Connect Google Workspace in *one click*. No passwords to copy.
Give each AI Employee only the tools it needs. Sending email? *It asks first.*
Assign a task in plain words, and watch every step happen *live*.
It checks company memory, queries the data, and reads the vendor's status page.
The manager, Ravi, hands parts of the job to *specialists*.
Before anything risky goes out, *a person decides*. Approve right from your inbox, or Slack.
Then the run picks up where it paused, with *every step logged*.
